## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by refining the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK exit parameters to increase win rate and avoid losses on J loser days, while maintaining profitability on winner days. The high win rate (93.2%) suggests the strategy is very selective, only taking trades when multiple entry conditions align. However, the edge_capture remains below the OP-16 floor, indicating insufficient capture of winner day PnL.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Requires volume breakout (vol_mult=1.1) with minimum candle body of 0.02 cents, at least 2 confirming signals (min_stars=2), break above open (require_break_above_open=true), and within proximity_dollars=1.5 of a level.  
**Exit:** Premium stop at -6% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at 40% of premium (selling 2/3 of position), runner target at 300% of premium, profit lock arms immediately (threshold=0%) and trails stop by 8% of premium once armed.  
**Position sizing:** 10 contracts.
